name: qa-paste-production
note: QA-authored. Runs after qa-production-smoke on the same pnpm start build (PORT=5290, BACKEND_PORT=3390): opening the app lands on the empty 'Pauta QA independente'. Paste is driven by a ClipboardEvent carrying a real DataTransfer, because browser:run has no clipboard step.

steps.expression: (() => { const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.setData('text/plain', 'Primeiro parágrafo do roteiro Segundo parágrafo do roteiro Terceiro parágrafo do roteiro'); dt.setData('text/html', 'Primeiro'); document.body.dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent('paste', { clipboardData: dt, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return true; })()

steps.text: 3 blocos criados: cada linha em branco separa um bloco.

steps.expression:
(() => { const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.setData('text/plain', '- Tópico A
  - Sub A1
    - Sub A2
- Tópico B'); document.body.dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent('paste', { clipboardData: dt, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return true; })()

fetch(location.hash.replace('#/rundown/', '/api/rundowns/') + '/sheet').then((r) => r.json()).then((j) => JSON.stringify(j.blocks.filter((b) => b.kind === 'text').map((b) => [b.content.map((r) => r.text).join(''), b.depth, b.size, b.content.some((r) => r.bold || r.color)])))

fetch(location.hash.replace('#/rundown/', '/api/rundowns/') + '/sheet').then((r) => r.json()).then((j) => { const by = Object.fromEntries(j.blocks.map((b) => [b.content.map((r) => r.text).join(''), b])); return [by['Tópico A'].depth, by['Sub A1'].depth, by['Sub A2'].depth, by['Tópico B'].depth, by['Sub A1'].size, by['Sub A2'].size].join(','); })

fetch(location.hash.replace('#/rundown/', '/api/rundowns/') + '/sheet').then((r) => r.json()).then((j) => j.blocks.filter((b) => b.kind === 'text').every((b) => b.content.every((r) => !r.bold && !r.color)) && j.blocks.some((b) => b.content.map((r) => r.text).join('') === 'Primeiro parágrafo do roteiro'))
steps.note: CRLF splits like LF and the pasted HTML formatting is discarded

steps.expression: new Promise((resolve) => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 64; c.height = 40; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.fillStyle = '#d4a017'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 40); c.toBlob((blob) => { const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([blob], 'print-qa.png', { type: 'image/png' })); document.body.dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent('paste', { clipboardData: dt, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); resolve(true); }, 'image/png'); })

new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 600)).then(() => { const img = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sheet-column] img[src*="/api/media/"]'); return Boolean(img && img.complete && img.naturalWidth === 64 && new URL(img.src).origin === location.origin); })
steps.note: After a reload the pasted print is served back from the media folder

steps.expression: fetch(location.hash.replace('#/rundown/', '/api/rundowns/') + '/sheet').then((r) => r.json()).then((j) => j.blocks.filter((b) => b.kind === 'image').map((b) => b.mediaName + ':' + (b.mediaMissing === false)).join(','))
